finding: The Server polled every 200 ms while waiting for human input, repeating budget reads and full phase orchestration; successful human-result persistence did not publish the existing progress sequence.
change: TeamCoordinator exposes a per-team watch subscription. Successful human-result recording advances progress. The runtime latch waits on progress, cancellation, and a 1-second budget heartbeat; only progress wakes phase orchestration. It subscribes and rechecks phase state to close the human-submit race.
regression_test_source: Added Core test for subscriber notification and latest-sequence delivery to late subscribers; not executed.

limitations: No Rust type-check or Rust test has run for this change. Event latency, race behavior, and measured idle-wait resource reduction remain unverified.
